guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice has the largest anomaly (latency-90 0.0046 -> 0.2134, z=+902.9), and its latency-50 also rose, so the slowdown is broad rather than tail-only. Its callers checkoutservice (p90 0.22 -> 4.14) and paymentservice (p90 0.0057 -> 0.2135) degrade in proportion, while the CPU series shown (checkoutservice, cartservice) are flat and no error or warning logs exist, which fits an injected delay rather than a resource fault.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect emailservice for network latency injection or a slow dependency, and restart or reschedule the emailservice pod if the delay persists; check checkoutservice timeouts so email slowness cannot stall checkout.
